subject.title: Add Claws manifest schema and read-only plan CLI

question: Should OpenClaw accept this read-only Claws manifest and CLI contract now, or wait until the draft RFC settles the v1 fields and strict-validation semantics?
rationale: This PR creates a new public CLI and schema surface whose compatibility and safety semantics will shape future ClawHub, workspace-file, and automation flows; static review cannot choose that product contract for maintainers.

options.title: Wait and tighten v1 before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open until the RFC direction is accepted or narrowed, then make the schema strict and explicitly model or reject all v1 fields before exposing the CLI.

options.title: Accept an experimental read-only slice
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally accept the current CLI as an early experiment, but should document that the schema is not the stable installer contract yet.

options.title: Pause this stack
options.body: If Claws is not the desired core direction, pause or close this implementation stack and route starter setup composition back to ClawHub or plugin-owned bundles.

recommendation.title: Wait and tighten v1 before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the RFC direction is accepted or narrowed, then make the schema strict and explicitly model or reject all v1 fields before exposing the CLI.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent current-main ownership signals in CLI registration and broad product/docs surfaces, making him the best available routing owner for the core CLI/product-contract decision.
